1: // Simple Meteor Shield game with enhanced graphics and sounds
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   // Audio setup
5:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
6:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
7:   // Ensure context is resumed on first user interaction
8:   const resumeAudio = () => {
9:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
10:     canvas.removeEventListener('mousemove', resumeAudio);
11:     canvas.removeEventListener('click', resumeAudio);
12:   };
13:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', resumeAudio);
14:   canvas.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio);
15: 
16:   function playTone(freq, duration = 0.1, type = 'sine') {
17:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
18:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
19:     oscillator.type = type;
20:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
21:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
23:     oscillator.start();
24:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
25:   }
26: 
27:   function playBounce() {
28:     playTone(440, 0.07, 'triangle'); // higher pitch on bounce
29:   }
30: 
31:   function playGameOverSound() {
32:     playTone(150, 0.5, 'sawtooth'); // low rumble
33:   }
34: 
35:   function playSpawn() {
36:     playTone(220, 0.05, 'square'); // subtle spawn cue
37:   }
38: 
39:   // Rest of the game starts below
40: 
41:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
42:   if (!canvas) return;
43:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
44:   const width = canvas.width;
45:   const height = canvas.height;
46: 
47:   // Pre‑generate simple star field
48:   const stars = [];
49:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
50:     stars.push({
51:       x: Math.random() * width,
52:       y: Math.random() * height,
53:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
54:     });
55:   }
56: 
57:   function drawBackground() {
58:     // Space gradient background
59:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
60:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0d001a');
61:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#20002b');
62:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
63:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
64:     // Draw stars
65:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
66:     stars.forEach(s => {
67:       ctx.beginPath();
68:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
69:       ctx.fill();
70:     });
71:   }
72: 
73:   // Shield
74:   const shield = {
75:     width: 100,
76:     height: 10,
77:     x: width / 2 - 50,
78:     y: height - 20,
79:     speed: 7,
80:   };
81: 
82:   // Meteor constructor
83:   class Meteor {
84:     constructor() {
85:       this.radius = 8 + Math.random() * 6;
86:       this.x = Math.random() * (width - this.radius * 2) + this.radius;
87:       this.y = -this.radius;
88:       this.vy = 2 + Math.random() * 2;
89:     }
90:     update() {
91:       this.y += this.vy;
92:     }
93:     draw() {
94:       // Meteor with radial gradient and slight glow
95:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x, this.y, this.radius * 0.2, this.x, this.y, this.radius);
96:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,200,150,0.9)');
97:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,87,34,0.6)');
98:       ctx.beginPath();
99:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
100:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
101:       ctx.fill();
102:       // optional glow effect
103:       ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,87,34,0.7)';
104:       ctx.shadowBlur = this.radius * 0.8;
105:       ctx.fill();
106:       ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset
107:     }
108:   }
109: 
110:   let meteors = [];
111:   let spawnTimer = 0;
112:   const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
113:   let score = 0;
114:   let gameOver = false;
115: 
116:   // Input: mouse moves shield horizontally
117:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
118:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
119:     const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
120:     shield.x = mouseX - shield.width / 2;
121:     // clamp
122:     shield.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - shield.width, shield.x));
123:   });
124: 
125:   function drawShield() {
126:     // Rounded shield with gradient
127:     const radius = 5;
128:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(shield.x, shield.y, shield.x, shield.y + shield.height);
129:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#64b5f6');
130:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#1976d2');
131:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
132:     ctx.beginPath();
133:     ctx.moveTo(shield.x + radius, shield.y);
134:     ctx.lineTo(shield.x + shield.width - radius, shield.y);
135:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(shield.x + shield.width, shield.y, shield.x + shield.width, shield.y + radius);
136:     ctx.lineTo(shield.x + shield.width, shield.y + shield.height - radius);
137:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(shield.x + shield.width, shield.y + shield.height, shield.x + shield.width - radius, shield.y + shield.height);
138:     ctx.lineTo(shield.x + radius, shield.y + shield.height);
139:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(shield.x, shield.y + shield.height, shield.x, shield.y + shield.height - radius);
140:     ctx.lineTo(shield.x, shield.y + radius);
141:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(shield.x, shield.y, shield.x + radius, shield.y);
142:     ctx.closePath();
143:     ctx.fill();
144:   }
145: 
146:   function checkCollision(meteor) {
147:     // Simple AABB circle collision with shield rectangle
148:     const withinX = meteor.x > shield.x && meteor.x < shield.x + shield.width;
149:     const touchingY = meteor.y + meteor.radius >= shield.y && meteor.y - meteor.radius <= shield.y + shield.height;
150:     return withinX && touchingY;
151:   }
152: 
153:   function loop(timestamp) {
154:     if (gameOver) {
155:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
156:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
157:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
158:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
159:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
160:       ctx.fillText('Game Over! Score: ' + score, width / 2, height / 2);
161:       return;
162:     }
163: 
164:     drawBackground();
165: 
166:     // Spawn meteors
167:     if (timestamp - spawnTimer > spawnInterval) {
168:       meteors.push(new Meteor());
169:       playSpawn();
170:       spawnTimer = timestamp;
171:     }
172: 
173:     // Update meteors
174:     meteors.forEach((m, i) => {
175:       m.update();
176:       // Collision with shield
177: if (checkCollision(m)) {
178:       m.vy = -m.vy; // bounce upward
179:       score++;
180:       playBounce();
181:     }
182:       // Check for game over (meteor reaches bottom)
183:       if (m.y - m.radius > height) {
184:         gameOver = true;
185:       }
186:       m.draw();
187:     });
188: 
189:     // Remove off‑screen meteors (above canvas after bounce)
190:     meteors = meteors.filter(m => m.y + m.radius >= 0 && m.y - m.radius <= height);
191: 
192:     drawShield();
193: 
194:     // Draw score
195:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
196:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
197:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
198: 
199:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
200:   }
201: 
202:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
203: })();
